rmt-2011-alg-01.title: Add up the deposits
rmt-2011-alg-01.body:
Let $x$ be the yearly deposit. The deposit made at age $8+j$ doubles every year until age 18, so it is worth $2^{10-j}x$ at 18, for $j=0,\dots,9$. The total is $x(2^{10}+2^9+\cdots+2)=2(2^{10}-1)x=2046x$. He needs $4\cdot45000=180000$, so $x\ge\frac{180000}{2046}\approx87.97$. The least integer is $88$.

**Answer: 88 dollars**

rmt-2011-alg-01.title: Year-by-year balance
rmt-2011-alg-01.body:
Let $B$ be the balance. Each year it doubles and then the next deposit is added: after the 10 deposits (the last one at 17) and one more doubling, $B=x(2+4+\cdots+2^{10})=2046x$. Since $2046\cdot87=178002<180000\le2046\cdot88=180048$, the answer is $88$.

**Answer: 88 dollars**
